note: Verdicts and timing counts on the slate match decision.json for all 12 tickets. The defect is in the trigger words. On CNK and FROG the trigger seats are livermore and wyckoff; wyckoff's own trigger says 'on rising volume', but the slate wording comes from livermore and drops it. Two more deciders (oneil, minervini) objected on exactly that missing volume test, and one more (wyckoff, FROG reservation) asked for it. Independent seats converging on one criticism marks the priority (C15), and it was never answered. So the slate does not fully say what its own trigger seats said. Process note: elder-lens's and seow's ratify objections repeat one method-level condition across tickets, so they carry less ticket evidence than their count suggests. No psychology claim (R9); no bracket basis (R1).
